# TABLELINK

> TABLELINK is a free restaurant technology platform based in Kampala, Uganda. It allows customers to scan QR codes, skip the wait, pre-order meals, and share tables. Restaurant owners use the TABLELINK dashboard to manage live orders, tables, and analytics.

## Features
- QR Code Ordering: Customers scan a code at their table to see the menu and order instantly.
- Live Dashboard: Restaurant owners track incoming orders in real-time.
- Table Reservations: Customers can book tables ahead of time.
- Group Dining: Allows users to split bills and share tables.
- Free for Restaurants: The platform is free for restaurant partners to use.
